instagram_caption:
Jesus, how long am I supposed to keep asking?

Same prayer, same words, long enough that she has started to feel silly saying it.

"Watch in hope. I hear you. I have heard every one."

Micah 7:7 is a decision more than a feeling: but as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord, I wait for God my Saviour, my God will hear me.

Unanswered is not the same as unheard. Keep asking.
